name: AudioBench
description: AudioBench is a universal benchmark designed to evaluate Audio Large Language Models across 8 distinct tasks and 26 datasets, including 7 newly proposed datasets. It targets speech understanding, audio scene understanding, and voice (paralinguistic) understanding, focusing on instruction-following capabilities conditioned on audio signals.
reputation: A recent benchmark from the AudioBench paper that has gained attention in audio-LLM evaluation, but it is still emerging rather than widely standardized.
notes: Includes 7 newly proposed datasets; provides open-sourced evaluation toolkit and leaderboard.
